description.value: The Fraser Lake Museum and Visitor Information Centre is housed in an original log home and presents exhibits on the rich history of the Fraser Lake area, including an informative display on Dakelh (Carrier) culture. Operated by the Village of Fraser Lake, it doubles as the community's official tourist information hub for visitors exploring regional outdoor activities such as canoeing, hiking, and trails at Mouse Mountain.

address.value: PO Box 430, 210 Carrier Cres. Fraser Lake, BC V0J 1S0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's visitors centre page confirms this is a legitimate seasonal museum and visitor information centre housed in an original log home, with exhibits on Fraser Lake history and Dakelh culture. No mention of bike-specific amenities (parking, washrooms, water) appears anywhere in the website content, so all amenity fields are null. The website provides a museum-specific phone number (250-699-8844) and a full civic address, neither of which appeared in the OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record had no phone or address; both were sourced from the website only.
Museum is seasonal (mid-May to mid-September); cyclists planning off-season visits will find it closed.
Website phone 250-699-8844 appears to be the museum/visitor centre line; the village office line is 250-699-6257 — OSM had neither, so no contradiction, but the distinction may be worth noting.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, free-admission municipal museum and visitor information centre in a small Central Interior community — a natural stop for touring cyclists seeking local history, cultural context, and regional trip-planning information.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tag fee=no corroborates the free-admission character of this municipal facility.

wow_evidence: Dupe winner: museum and visitor info centre in an original log home, with a Dakelh (Carrier) culture exhibit.
blurb: Fraser Lake's log-home museum and visitor centre, with Dakelh culture exhibits.
